bridge: chart scanning (finding patterns across ranking samples)

definition.en: 扫榜 (sǎo bǎng, 'chart scanning') means reading ranking and recommendation samples to find repeated patterns such as genre, protagonist setup and opening angle. Oh Story's scan workflow treats a single title's rank as a lead to check, reports patterns that several samples support as observations, and lists the rest as ideas to validate next.
definition.zh: 扫榜是阅读平台榜单与推荐样本，从中找出题材、主角人设、开局切入点等反复出现的模式。Oh Story 的扫榜把单本排名当线索，多个样本都支持的规律才写成观察，其余列为待验证的想法。

in_practice.en: `/story-long-scan` prefers platform collectors when available, then ranking data the user supplies; built-in knowledge is a last resort and is labeled as such in the report. The report records evidence, risks and next validation steps, and when data is missing or thin it caps feasibility at medium and says to validate first. Sources: [Purpose and evidence hierarchy](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-scan/SKILL.md#L44-L170) · [Report and uncertainty rules](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-scan/SKILL.md#L235-L292).
in_practice.zh: `/story-long-scan` 优先使用可用的平台采集脚本，其次使用用户提供的榜单数据，内置知识只作最后的降级来源，并在报告里标明。报告写明证据、风险和下一步验证动作；数据缺失或样本偏少时，可行性评估最高给到「中」，并写明要先验证。 源码依据：[目标与数据优先级](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-scan/SKILL.md#L44-L170) · [报告与不确定性规则](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-scan/SKILL.md#L235-L292)。

bridge: deconstruction (analyzing a reference text into reusable story components)

definition.en: 拆文 (chāi wén) is structured analysis of a reference work: outline rhythm, plot modules, emotional beats, character functions, style and setting. Oh Story organizes the findings as analytical reference material and a personal module library for later writing.
definition.zh: 拆文是对参考作品做结构化分析，拆出大纲节奏、剧情模块、情绪节拍、角色功能、文风与设定。Oh Story 把拆出的结果整理成分析性的参考资料和个人模块库，供后续写作调用。

in_practice.en: `/story-long-analyze` starts with a three-chapter preview and asks whether to continue; when the creator has already asked for a complete run, it still writes the preview and then keeps going. Its staged outputs include an overview, analysis report, style notes, chapters, characters, plot material and settings, and the output templates define what each stage records. Sources: [Staged analysis](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-analyze/SKILL.md#L139-L149) · [Output templates](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-analyze/references/output-templates.md#L63-L109).
in_practice.zh: `/story-long-analyze` 先拆前三章并产出快速预览，再问是否继续；创作者一开始就要求完整拆解时，照样产出预览，然后直接往下跑。分阶段产物包括概要、拆文报告、文风、章节、角色、剧情素材与设定，每个阶段记录什么由输出模板规定。 源码依据：[阶段化拆文](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-analyze/SKILL.md#L139-L149) · [输出模板](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-analyze/references/output-templates.md#L63-L109)。

bridge: de-AI editing / de-slop (bounded editing of formulaic prose patterns)

definition.en: 去AI味 (qù AI wèi, 'removing the AI flavor') is editing out formulaic phrasing and repeated sentence patterns common in model output so prose reads naturally. Oh Story runs deterministic pattern checks first, then makes bounded minimal edits that change how things are said while plot, characters and timeline stay as written. The checkers flag named text patterns; the edit itself is judged by how the prose reads.
definition.zh: 去AI味是把文本里常见于模型输出的套式表达、空泛情绪和重复句式改掉，让文字回到具体、自然、可读。Oh Story 先做确定性的模式检查，再在边界内做最小改写：只改怎么说，剧情、人设和时间线保持原样。检查器报出指定的文字模式，改稿以读感为准。

in_practice.en: `/story-deslop` runs `check-ai-patterns.js` and `check-degeneration.js`, makes bounded minimal edits and scans again. Blocking degeneration such as unrecoverable truncation sends that passage back for regeneration; polishing handles wording-level problems. Sources: [Editing boundaries](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-deslop/SKILL.md#L21-L49) · [Checks and degeneration](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-deslop/SKILL.md#L186-L197).
in_practice.zh: `/story-deslop` 运行 `check-ai-patterns.js` 与 `check-degeneration.js`，按边界做最小修改后再扫一遍。遇到不可恢复的截断等阻断级退化，流程会让那一段回去重新生成，润色只处理措辞层面的问题。 源码依据：[编辑边界](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-deslop/SKILL.md#L21-L49) · [检查与退化信号](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-deslop/SKILL.md#L186-L197)。

bridge: motion comic / animated drama (rather than live-action short drama)

definition.en: 漫剧 (màn jù, 'motion comic') is a short serialized drama told through animated or comic-style imagery, as opposed to live-action footage. In Drama Skills, the production profile the creator accepts is recorded in the project for the later stages that need it. Creators can start from an existing screenplay, visual design, storyboard or prompt task, and only the documents that step needs get written.
definition.zh: 漫剧是用动画或漫画风格画面讲述的短篇连续剧，与真人实拍的短剧相对。在 Drama Skills 中，创作者接受的制作形态档案会记在项目里，供后续相关阶段读取。创作者可以从已有的剧本、视觉设定、分镜或提示词中任选一步直接进入，只写这一步需要的文档。

in_practice.en: Drama Skills keeps up to five kinds of creator-readable Markdown documents per episode, and each request creates only the ones it actually needs. Frozen-keyframe prompts and continuity-lock phrases write selected constraints down, and a validator checks them word for word; cross-shot consistency in generated media is checked against the images once they exist. Sources: [Creator-first workflow](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama/references/creator-workflow.md#L3-L34) · [Continuity-lock obligations](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama-assets/references/continuity-lock.md#L22-L49).
in_practice.zh: Drama Skills 每集按需维护最多五类创作者可直接阅读的 Markdown 文档，一个请求只创建它实际需要的那几份。冻结关键帧提示词与连续性锁把选定的约束写明，并由校验器逐字检查；生成画面是否跨镜一致，出图后再对照画面检查。 源码依据：[按需创作流程](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama/references/creator-workflow.md#L3-L34) · [连续性锁义务](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama-assets/references/continuity-lock.md#L22-L49)。

bridge: golden three chapters (an early-opening analysis checkpoint)

definition.en: 黄金三章 ('golden three chapters') is a serial's opening three chapters, read as one unit to check that premise, conflict, hooks and payoffs land early. It is a common web-fiction writing convention, and Oh Story uses the same unit as a preview checkpoint before a full deconstruction.
definition.zh: 黄金三章指连载网文的开篇三章，写作者把它当作一个整体，检查设定、冲突、钩子与爽点有没有尽早立住。它是网文写作的惯用说法，Oh Story 也把这三章用作完整拆文之前的预览检查点。

in_practice.en: Stage 1 of `/story-long-analyze` produces the opening preview and asks whether to continue; when the creator has already asked for a complete run, it still writes the preview and then keeps going. The templates record chapter-level hooks, conflict, pacing and payoffs as craft analysis. Sources: [Preview checkpoint](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-analyze/SKILL.md#L139-L149) · [Three-chapter analysis](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-analyze/references/output-templates.md#L77-L142). For your own serial opening, [how to write the golden three chapters](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/novel-opening) plans an original first three chapters around what to pay off and which question to hand on.
in_practice.zh: `/story-long-analyze` 第一阶段产出开篇预览，再询问是否继续；创作者一开始就要求完整拆解时，照样产出预览，然后直接往下跑。模板逐章记录钩子、冲突、节奏与爽点，结论落在写法分析上。 源码依据：[预览检查点](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-analyze/SKILL.md#L139-L149) · [三章拆解字段](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-analyze/references/output-templates.md#L77-L142)。 要写自己的连载开头，见[黄金三章怎么写](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/novel-opening)：用原创三章方案演示先兑现什么、再抛出什么问题。

bridge: payoff beat (a planned moment of emotional satisfaction)

definition.en: 爽点 (shuǎng diǎn, 'payoff beat') is a planned moment of emotional payoff that answers an expectation built by earlier conflict or setup. Oh Story writes the intended payoff into chapter planning and examines how reference works place their payoffs during analysis.
definition.zh: 爽点是预先规划的情绪兑现时刻，用来回应前文冲突或铺垫建立起来的期待。Oh Story 在章节规划里写明本章的预期爽点，拆文时也分析参考作品怎样安排爽点。

in_practice.en: The long-form outline-contract checker requires a 爽点 field. Analysis templates record the source chapter's payoff and its setup separately. Structural validation confirms the planning field is filled in; whether the scene lands emotionally is judged by reading the prose. Sources: [Required outline fields](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-write/scripts/check-outline-contract.js#L20-L28) · [Payoff analysis](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-analyze/references/output-templates.md#L128-L150).
in_practice.zh: 长篇细纲契约检查器把「爽点」列为必填字段。拆文模板分别记录参考章节的爽点与对应铺垫。结构校验确认规划里写了爽点，场景读起来爽不爽，靠作者通读正文来判断。 源码依据：[细纲必填字段](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-write/scripts/check-outline-contract.js#L20-L28) · [爽点分析字段](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-analyze/references/output-templates.md#L128-L150)。

bridge: hook (an opening, ending or paragraph-level reason to keep reading)

definition.en: 钩子 (gōu zi, 'hook') is a device at a chapter break or inside a paragraph that pulls the reader onward, such as an open question, a countdown or a reversal. In serialized web fiction, a chapter-ending hook, such as a line of dialogue left hanging, carries interest into the next installment, including across a paywall.
definition.zh: 钩子是放在章节边界或段落内部、推着读者继续往下读的设计，常见形式有未回答的问题、倒计时、反转和没说完的对白。在连载网文中，章尾钩子负责把读者的兴趣带进下一章，遇到付费章节，也要把读者带过那道门槛。

in_practice.en: Oh Story's references document 13 chapter-ending forms, 7 chapter-opening forms and paragraph-level hooks. The long-form chapter-blueprint checker requires a 章首钩子 (opening hook) field; the check confirms the field is filled in, and the author judges how well the hook reads. Sources: [Hook forms](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/README.md#L376-L382) · [Blueprint fields](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-write/scripts/check-outline-contract.js#L21-L26). To choose and write a chapter-ending hook by type, see [chapter-ending hooks](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/chapter-ending-hooks).
in_practice.zh: Oh Story 的参考文档列出章尾钩子 13 式、章首钩子 7 式和段落级钩子。长篇章节蓝图的结构检查器要求填写「章首钩子」字段；检查确认这一栏已经写上，钩子读起来有没有力，由作者读稿判断。 源码依据：[钩子分类](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/README.md#L376-L382) · [蓝图字段](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-write/scripts/check-outline-contract.js#L21-L26)。 按类型挑选和改写章尾钩子，见[章尾钩子写法](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/chapter-ending-hooks)。

definition.en: 套路 (tào lù) is a familiar, reusable story pattern in web fiction, translated as 'trope' or 'formula'. Oh Story sums up its craft framework as 套路 = 确定性的情绪满足 ('a trope is dependable emotional satisfaction'): studying a trope means working out which emotional payoff the pattern is built to deliver.
definition.zh: 套路指网文里反复使用、读者一看就熟悉的叙事模式，英文可译为 trope 或 formula。Oh Story 用「套路 = 确定性的情绪满足」概括自己的创作框架：学套路，就是弄清一种熟悉的模式要兑现哪一种情绪。

in_practice.en: The README lays the method out in three steps: scan the charts for genre, character setup and opening angle; deconstruct works into a personal module library; then apply hooks, payoffs and anticipation in commercial writing. The framework runs along four lines: reverse-engineering successful works, recombining plot modules, managing context and state in layers, and keeping a human in the loop. Sources: [Project method](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/README.md#L13-L23).
in_practice.zh: README 把方法论分成三步：扫榜看题材、人设与切入点，拆文建立个人模块库，再在商业化写作中运用钩子、爽感与期待感。整套框架围绕四条线展开：爆款逆向、剧情模块化重组、上下文状态分层管理和人机协同。 源码依据：[项目核心思路](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/README.md#L13-L23)。

bridge: episode map (a series-level handoff plan for later writing)

definition.en: 分集地图 (fēn jí dì tú, 'episode map') is an episode-by-episode handoff plan for a short-drama series. For each episode it records the incoming state, objective and opposition, turn, local result, information release, outgoing pressure, precise handoff, continuity changes and open questions. In Drama Skills, later writing sessions pick up each episode from this map, so the handoffs of a long series stay explicit.
definition.zh: 分集地图是短剧系列的逐集交接计划，每集记录进入状态、目标与阻力、方向性转折、当集结果、信息释放、出去压力、精确交接、连续性变化和未决项。在 Drama Skills 中，后续写作会话按这份地图接续每一集，长系列的交接因此写在明处。

in_practice.en: `short-drama-develop` creates or revises an episode map when the creator needs episode planning, loading genre and hook references as needed. A director's statement is an optional candidate, drafted alongside it when the project calls for one. Sources: [Episode-map fields](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama-develop/references/episode-design.md#L328-L340) · [Development scope](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama-develop/SKILL.md#L84-L106).
in_practice.zh: 创作者需要分集规划时，`short-drama-develop` 创建或修订分集地图；题材与钩子参考按需加载。导演阐述是可选的候选文档，项目需要时才一并起草。 源码依据：[分集地图字段](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama-develop/references/episode-design.md#L328-L340) · [开发阶段边界](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama-develop/SKILL.md#L84-L106)。

bridge: director's statement (a candidate visual direction and production profile)

definition.en: 导演阐述 (dǎo yǎn chǎn shù, 'director's statement') is a document that sets a project's visual direction and production constraints. In Drama Skills it starts as a candidate director brief; once the creator accepts it, its visual_direction / production_profile become the project's authoritative creative decisions and constrain downstream work.
definition.zh: 导演阐述是写明项目整体视觉方向与生产约束的文档，写在分集拆分和分镜之前，经创作者接受后约束全剧的后续工作。在 Drama Skills 中，它先作为候选导演简报起草，接受后其中的 visual_direction / production_profile 提升为项目生效的创作决策（creator authority），从这时起约束下游。

in_practice.en: Look Development is an optional branch that turns an accepted direction into observable text style-frame specifications before formal storyboarding. It produces specifications and prompts only; actual images go through `short-drama-produce` after the creator confirms the job preview. Sources: [Accepting a director brief](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama-develop/references/director-brief-craft.md#L10-L16) · [Look Development scope](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama/references/look-development.md#L3-L18).
in_practice.zh: Look Development 是可选分支，可以在正式分镜前把已接受的方向写成可观察的文本风格帧规格。这一阶段只产出规格和提示词；要实际出图，交给 `short-drama-produce`，由创作者确认任务预览后再生成。 源码依据：[导演阐述生效边界](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama-develop/references/director-brief-craft.md#L10-L16) · [Look Development 边界](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama/references/look-development.md#L3-L18)。

bridge: frozen keyframe prompt (a specification for the visible shot-start frame)

definition.en: 冻结关键帧 (dòng jié guān jiàn zhēn, 'frozen keyframe') is the prompt or specification for the visible start of a shot in a Drama Skills storyboard. It inherits screenplay and visual facts, and any active continuity-lock phrase is copied into it verbatim. Generating and approving the image are separate, later steps.
definition.zh: 冻结关键帧是 Drama Skills 分镜里描述镜头可见起点的提示词或规格，写的是这一镜开始时画面里有什么。它继承剧本与视觉设定中的事实，生效连续性锁的锁面要原样写进提示词。出图和审图是之后单独进行的步骤。

in_practice.en: It belongs to storyboarding and describes only its declared boundary, the start by default. An actual image becomes a usable starting-frame reference once it is generated or supplied and bound as a `REF-` asset. A lock constrains the prompt text; consistency in the generated images is checked once they exist. Sources: [Storyboard contract](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama-storyboard/SKILL.md#L50-L104) · [Production and reference binding](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama-produce/SKILL.md#L15-L23).
